text: Entering this brightly lit, modern laboratory or exhibition space, I am filled with curiosity and anticipation. The colorful and bold R+D lettering suggests a focus on research and development, sparking thoughts about our ceaseless pursuit of innovation. The glass and screens reflect both transparency and the layering of knowledge, making me feel small yet eager—a traveler at the threshold of discovery. I am eager to learn what new ideas or inventions might be revealed in this space.
